LanguageData.LP_Titan.label: celestial titanborn
LanguageData.LP_Titan.description: A demigod fallen from the heavens, with golden-bronze skin, white hair and a faint golden halo hanging over its head. Titanborn are two and a half times the height of ordinary people, immensely strong, able to call down lightning of divine punishment and close companions' wounds with a divine breath; when happy the sky clears, when upset thunderstorms rage. They can't reproduce, and refuse to admit anything in the world is greater than themselves.
LanguageData.LP_Titan.descriptionShort: Legendary race, not inheritable. Body size ×2.5 (giant body: health ×1.75, melee ×1.45), divine might resource, divine punishment and titanborn's breath, immune to stuns, affects weather; hot-tempered, arrogant.
